integrity: Both displayed polynomials are obtained from complete enumeration of all \(2^{15}\) spanning subgraphs with an exact \(\mathbb F_2\) coboundary test for locality. The dual polynomial is also checked by direct enumeration of the antipodal dodecahedral quotient and by the published cellular-duality identity; no sampling or extrapolation is used.
limitations: The computation concerns the regular antipodal quotient embeddings of \(K_6\) and its hemi-dodecahedral dual. It does not classify other embeddings of the same abstract graphs, and an unindexed older computation in an equivalent topological Tutte formalism remains a residual literature risk.
title: Myopic Tutte polynomials of the regular projective dual pair
